notes:
{文章|ぶんしょう} refers to written text, passages, or writing style.

WRITING:
⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (writing, sentence) + ⟦{章|しょう}→章：03768_shou⟧ (chapter, section)

HIERARCHY OF TEXT:
- ⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧: character
- ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧/⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧: word
- ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧: sentence
- {文章|ぶんしょう}: text/passage
- ⟦{段落|だんらく}→段落：14932_danraku⟧: paragraph

- {文章|ぶんしょう}{力|りょく}: writing ability
